# LearnerVerse
> Turn any YouTube playlist into a structured, AI-powered learning experience.

## About
LearnerVerse is an educational web application that transforms YouTube videos and playlists into organized, structured courses. Paste a URL and the platform uses AI to create sections, generate quizzes, track your learning progress with streaks, award verifiable certificates, and provide an inline AI tutor called LiVi.

## URL
https://learnerverse.xyz

## Features
- **One-Click Import**: Paste any YouTube video or playlist URL to create a structured course instantly.
- **AI Course Organization**: AI automatically organizes videos into logical sections and lessons.
- **AI-Generated Quizzes**: Auto-generated quiz questions after every lesson to reinforce learning.
- **LiVi AI Tutor**: An inline AI tutor that answers questions about any lesson in real time.
- **Progress Tracking**: Track course completion percentage and build learning streaks.
- **Certificates**: Earn and share verifiable completion certificates.
- **Course Hub**: Discover and share community-created courses publicly.
- **Focus Timer**: Built-in Pomodoro timer for productive study sessions.
- **Study Notes**: Take timestamped notes while watching lessons.
- **Dark/Light Mode**: Full theme support.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite, TanStack Query
- Backend: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy (async), PostgreSQL
- Auth: Auth0 (JWT RS256)
- AI: OpenRouter API
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend), FastAPI Cloud (backend)
